dm.title: 🏢 Office planning – week {week} ({range})
dm.question:
Which days will you be in the office {when}?
Select all that apply:
dm.status.empty: ⏳ No answer saved yet. No selection + Save = no office day.
dm.hint: You can make changes until {deadline}. They only take effect once you click *Save*.
dm.superseded: ↪️ This message has been replaced by a new one. Please use the latest message below.
dm.away: 🌴 You are marked as away this week. You will not get any reminders, and the summary lists you as away.
dm.away.hint: In the office after all? Until {deadline} you can undo the absence and pick your days.
dm.away.answered: You have already answered and this week has started, so it can no longer be marked as away as a whole. Please use 🌴 Plan time off to enter your time off from today on.
reminder.text: ⏰ Reminder: Please let us know which days you will be in the office in week {week} – by {deadline}.
summary.title: 🏢 Office attendance – week {week} ({range})
summary.unreachable: ⚠️ Message could not be delivered to: {names}
summary.project: ⭐ Like this bot? <{url}|Rate it on GitHub>
timeoff.title: Time off
timeoff.intro: On these days you get no poll and no reminders. If you are away for a whole week, the channel summary lists you as away.
timeoff.error.order: The last day must not be before the first day.
timeoff.error.past: The first day must not be in the past.
timeoff.error.too_far: Time off can be planned at most one year ahead.
timeoff.error.failed: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
language.name: English
language.title: Language
language.intro: Which language should I use when I write to you? It applies to your poll, reminders and replies. The channel summary stays in the team language.
language.label: Language
reply.try_again: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
reply.save_unavailable: Saving is not possible right now. Please try again in a moment.
reply.save_failed: Your selection could not be saved. Please try again.
reply.unreadable: Your selection could not be read. Please try again.
reply.not_participant: You are not registered for this poll.
reply.stale_dm: Please use the current poll message.
reply.stale_summary: Please use this week's current overview.

reply.not_eligible: You are not part of the group for this poll. If you have questions, please contact the person who runs the bot.
reply.late_joiner_added: 📩 You have been added to this week's poll. I will send it to you by direct message shortly.
